name: Café Käfer
kurzbeschreibung: Café Käfer in Tarrenz Welcome to Café Käfer, a cozy hideaway nestled in the heart of Tarrenz, a charming village in the Tirol Alps.
beschreibung: The Café Käfer in Tarrenz in the Imst region invites visitors to take an enjoyable break. This stylish café and confectionery delights its guests with a wide selection of homemade cakes, tarts, and sweet specialties. Each creation is crafted with great attention to detail and artfully presented. In addition, exquisite coffee specialties prepared to perfection by experienced baristas are served. The cozy atmosphere with charming interior invites you to linger and enjoy. Whether for breakfast, afternoon coffee, or a small snack in between – everyone feels warmly welcome here.
